identificationModule.briefTitle: A Study of Intravesical SHR-1501 Combination With BCG Versus Investigator-selected Chemotherapy in Subjects With BCG-unresponsive NMIBC
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Multicenter, Randomized, Open-label Phase III Clinical Study of Intravesical SHR-1501 Combined With Bacillus Calmette Guerin (BCG) Versus Investigator-selected Chemotherapy In Patients With BCG-unresponsive Papillary-Only Non-muscle-invasive Bladder Cancer (NMIBC) (NiBladder 1)

descriptionModule.briefSummary: This is a multicenter, randomized, open-label phase III study to determine the efficacy and safety of intravesical SHR-1501 combined with Bacillus Calmette Guerin (BCG) versus investigator-selected chemotherapy in patients with BCG-unresponsive papillary-only non-muscle-invasive bladder cancer (NMIBC).

designInfo.interventionModelDescription: A randomized, positive controlled, open-label study.

armGroups.label: Investigator-selected Chemotherapy Group
armGroups.description: Epirubicin or Pirarubicin or Gemcitabine or Hydroxycamptothecin or Mitomycin.

primaryOutcomes.measure: Disease-Free Survival (DFS) assessed by Blinded Independent Central Review (BICR)
primaryOutcomes.description: Disease free survival is defined as the time from randomization to date of DFS event assessed by BICR.

secondaryOutcomes.description: Disease-free survival (DFS) is defined as the time from randomization to date of DFS event assessed by investigator.
Overall Survival (OS) is defined as the time from randomization to date of death from any cause.

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Number of adverse events (AEs) as assessed by CTCAE v6.0.
Number of serious adverse events (SAEs) as assessed by CTCAE v6.0.

locations.facility: Renji Hospital Affiliated to Shanghai Jiao Tong University School
